**SECTION D: COMPOSITION (10 MARKS)**

*Write a composition of between 200 and 250 words on ONE of the following topics.*

**Topic 1**

questions.enonce_markdown: You have noticed an increase in teenage pregnancies in your village, and many of these girls cannot continue school because their parents want them to marry or do odd jobs. As a community youth leader, address the parents on Youth Day: explain the causes, say what can be done to reduce or stop the phenomenon, and give valid reasons why they should not stop educating their pregnant daughters. *(200 to 250 words)*
questions.corrige_markdown:
### Rappel de méthode
Un discours s'adresse oralement à un auditoire présent : il s'ouvre par une formule d'adresse (*Dear parents, ladies and gentlemen*), annonce son objet, développe chaque point demandé dans un paragraphe distinct, emploie *you*, *we* et *let us* pour impliquer l'auditoire, puis se termine par un appel à agir et une formule de clôture (*Thank you for listening*).

**Ce que le sujet impose.** Le texte est un discours (*address the parents*) prononcé à l'occasion de la Journée de la jeunesse. Quatre contenus sont obligatoires : les causes, les solutions pour réduire le phénomène, des raisons de ne pas retirer les filles enceintes de l'école, et un ton qui encourage les parents sans les accuser. Le plan suit cet ordre.

**Discours modèle.**

**Good morning, dear parents, distinguished guests and fellow youths.**

I stand before you today, on this Youth Day, to speak about a problem that is hurting our village: the growing number of teenage pregnancies.

Several causes explain it. Some parents are too busy to talk to their children about sex and its consequences. Poverty pushes certain girls to accept gifts and money from older men. Peer pressure, bad influence from films and social media, and a lack of sex education also play a part.

What can we do? First, let us talk openly with our daughters and sons, and listen to them. Secondly, schools, churches and health centres should organise regular talks on responsible behaviour. Finally, let us provide our children with their basic needs, so that they do not look for them elsewhere.

Now I appeal to the parents of the girls who are already pregnant: please do not stop their education, and do not push them into marriage or odd jobs. A girl who returns to school will get a good job tomorrow, take care of her baby and contribute to the development of our community. Marrying her off early will only prolong her suffering and her child's. Education is her right and her best protection against poverty.

Let us support these girls instead of punishing them.

**Thank you for listening.**

### Piège à éviter
N'écris pas un essai : un discours doit s'ouvrir sur une formule d'adresse et se fermer sur une formule de clôture. Oublier l'une des deux te fait perdre des points de forme.

### Conseil
Compte tes mots paragraphe par paragraphe : six paragraphes de 30 à 45 mots te placent naturellement dans la fourchette de 200 à 250 mots.
